In Revelation, the third horseman rides a black horse symbolizing famine (Rev 6:5), and the sun turns black at cosmic upheaval (Rev 6:12). The consistent 'black/negro/noir/schwarz' pattern across languages shows universal recognition of this basic color term."

  Sense 1: ""
